components.name: Fine arch
components.description: Opening cover stationery frame only. The main hero is unframed. Cover florals use 260px below 768px and 430px above; footer uses 240px and 330px. The hero uses 145px/135px mobile bouquets and 24vw/21vw bouquets from 768px, over a full-width cloudy lavender backplate.

narrative.overview: An ivory arch-framed opening cover leads into the user’s reference-led main hero: cloudy lavender watercolor, colored bouquets and opposite botanical line art, a JR monogram, date and time above oversized one-line Joy & Rolly calligraphy, and uppercase invitation prose. The full names and functional countdown remain immediately below the hero. Other invitation sections and the opening interaction retain their approved design.
keyCharacteristics: Plum calligraphic names with refined serif headings.
Ivory paper, pale colored section fields, and hairline rules.
Original transparent watercolor florals reused at opposing corners.
A separate opening cover with a guarded transition and focus handoff.
Flat, spacious content with a minimal RSVP preview.
Ivory satin countdown with lavender lilies, a script heading, and four live dark plum numeric fields.
User-supplied church and reception photographs in 4:3 responsive frames above the unchanged venue details.
Hero uses original designs/flower-1.png, flower-2.png, and monogram.png over a decoration-free lavender wash; source PNGs remain unchanged.
Mobile-friendly compact opening, a touch Menu below 1024px, larger phone copy, stacked timeline, and safe 200% text reflow.

rules.name: The Bouquet Rule
rules.body: Preserve the distinction between the source bouquet palette, the pale interface fields, and the named attire swatches.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Reserve script for the couple's names, serif for invitation information and headings, and sans-serif for instructions and controls.

rules.name: The Separate States Rule
rules.body: Never reveal or activate the main invitation while the opening cover still owns the experience.

dos: Do preserve the plum, pale paper fields, fine arches, and transparent watercolor material.
Do use the three established font roles and reuse their existing root resources.
Do keep layouts flexible, retain keyboard focus, and respect reduced motion.
Do keep the RSVP explicitly local preview until the user's admin configuration is available.
donts: Don't invent missing photographs, stories, or entourage entries.
Don't replace the opening interaction with a scroll to the next section.
Don't let the cover and main invitation become visible and interactive together.
Don't apply the marketing site's visual system to this client invitation.
